The team were nicknamed ''Keramičari'' (The ceramics makers), because they were sponsored by a ceramics factory through much of their history) or ''Div iz predgrađa'' (The giant from the suburb). The team's colours are yellow and blue. Home games at [[Ivan Laljak-Ivić Stadium]]. On 20 July 2022, Inter has dissolved due to financial issues.{{cite web|url=https://www.total-croatia-news.com/sport/64450-inter-zapresic|title=After 93 Years, Historic Croatian Football Club Going Bankrupt?
